about: KEM binding v2 (release-compatibility SIGNED_FORMATS 2.3; docs/contracts/ACCOUNT_CARD.md, KEM binding): sign_bytes are frozen (hex); each receive case gives the receiver's verdict (SIGNED_FORMATS 1.1), then wrong_account when the signing key does not hash to account_id. Signatures are randomized: compare without kem_binding_b64, and check the committed bindings give their verdicts.
